messages.守備「時間貸与 - 共振」で時間貸与を切らさず、クイックとマッチ威力増加を得て序: A Tremor Identity that keeps Borrowed Time active through Borrowed Time - Microcavity, gaining Haste and Clash Power Up for strong early clashes. S2's Amplitude Conversion and S3's Time Moratorium weaken enemies while sustaining Tremor Count.
messages.時間貸与: 守備を使うターンの戦闘開始時に時間貸与状態でなければ、ターン終了時に: **Borrowed Time**: If she is not in Borrowed Time at Combat Start on a turn she uses her Defense skill, she gains 4 Borrowed Time at Turn End (once per turn). With 2 or more Count at Turn End, she gains (Count − 1) Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile each next turn. If Bind exceeds that Haste, Borrowed Time ends and she is staggered. At the end of the turn Count reaches 1, she gains (Potency − 1)×2 Bind next turn.
messages.守備「時間貸与 - 共振」: 破壊不能コインを持つマッチ可能ガード。マッチ勝利で: **Defense skill — Borrowed Time - Microcavity**: A Clashable Guard with an Unbreakable Coin. On Clash Win, +2 Tremor Count for the target and herself; on Clash Lose, +4 to her own Tremor Count. Through the combat passive Golden Time - Microcavity (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), skills gain +1 Final Power during Borrowed Time.
messages.S2「T社共振モジュール」: 使用時に自分の振動回数+4。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインで振動2ず: **S2 — T Corp. Microcavity Module**: +4 to her own Tremor Count on use. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 2 Tremor each. If the target is not in an Amplitude Conversion or Amplitude Entanglement state, Coin Ⅲ spends 3 of her own Tremor Count to convert it into Tremor - Chain (−1 Clash Power per 10 Tremor Potency, up to 3); if it already is, that Coin deals +60% damage.
messages.S3「T社3型徴収鉄槌最大展開」: 自分が時間貸与を持っていれば、Ⅲコインで振動: **S3 — T-3 Collector Mace Max Activation**: If she has Borrowed Time, Coin Ⅲ adds an extra Tremor Burst and inflicts 2 Time Moratorium. Coin Ⅲ spends all of her own Tremor Count, gaining +1 Coin Power per 5 (up to 5) and +2% damage per point (up to 100%; 1%, up to 50%, at lower Uptie). After the attack, her Borrowed Time disappears and she gains Violent Collections (once per battle).
messages.時間猶予: 付与されている間、対象は全ダメージを受けずにストックし、回数1で戦闘: **Time Moratorium**: While applied, the target takes no damage and stores it instead, and when the battle ends at Count 1, it takes Sloth damage equal to (100 + Potency×15)% of the stored amount and a Tremor Burst. Applying more triggers it on the spot and removes it.
messages.序盤から守備で時間貸与を得て、以後も切らさないように使い、クイックとマッチ威力増: Gain Borrowed Time with her Defense skill from the start and keep using it so it never lapses, taking Clashes with Haste and Clash Power Up. Early on, S2's conversion into Tremor - Chain lowers enemy Clash Power, and after conversion, Coin Ⅲ's damage increase turns it toward damage. Once Tremor Count builds up, spend it all at once with S3 to apply Time Moratorium. Borrowed Time disappears after S3's attack, so she avoids the Count-1 Bind penalty and can chain into the next Borrowed Time. However, Tremor - Chain's Clash Power Down is 1 per 10 Tremor Potency, while her own Tremor Potency infliction is only S2's 2+2, falling short of 10. Making the Clash Power Down count requires Tremor Identities among her allies to supply Tremor Potency.
